CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learners (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  streak INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_practice_date TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS item_states (
  learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learners(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mastery DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lapses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stability DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  due_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  last_reviewed_at BIGINT,
  PRIMARY KEY (learner_id, item_id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS item_states_due_idx ON item_states (learner_id, due_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS practice_days (
  learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learners(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  answers INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  correct INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (learner_id, day)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  email_norm TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT,
  google_sub TEXT UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_google_sub_idx ON users (google_sub)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sessions_user_idx ON sessions (user_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS magic_links (
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email_norm TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS magic_links_email_idx ON magic_links (email_norm)
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
